jobs.title: Geospatial Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The **Geospatial Systems Administrator** provisions, configures, secures, and maintains AWS-hosted infrastructure and ArcGIS Server environments. The position supports reliable system operations through monitoring, incident response, patch management, security configuration, and compliance documentation.

**Work Setting:**

* This position offers the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in the United States, subject to business requirements.
* Travel < 10%

**Salary Range:** $100,000 - $117,000 per year. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, and location, in addition to market and business considerations.

  
Responsibilities:

**AWS Infrastructure Administration**

* Provision and configure AWS infrastructure to support application and geospatial service requirements.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity
* Maintain cloud resource configurations and troubleshoot infrastructure availability, connectivity, and performance issues.
* Document infrastructure architecture, configuration changes, and operational procedures.

**ArcGIS Server Administration**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot ArcGIS Server environments.
* Publish, configure, update, and manage ArcGIS Server services.
* Diagnose service availability and performance issues and coordinate resolution with application and GIS stakeholders.
* Apply software updates and configuration changes to support secure, reliable service delivery.

**Monitoring and Incident Response**

* Monitor Amazon CloudWatch alarms and investigate infrastructure and application alerts.
* Assess operational impact, perform corrective actions, and escalate issues as appropriate.
* Document incidents, troubleshooting activities, corrective actions, and resolutions.
* Maintain monitoring configurations and operational response procedures.

**Security and Compliance**

* Prepare and maintain security compliance documentation, including Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) checklists and supporting evidence.
* Assess system configurations against applicable security requirements and document findings.
* Implement approved security configurations and remediate identified deficiencies.
* Maintain records of compliance activities, configuration decisions, and remediation status.

**Patch and Configuration Management**

* Plan, test, and apply operating system and application patches.
* Coordinate maintenance activities to minimize service disruption.
* Verify system functionality following patching and configuration changes.
* Maintain patching records, system configuration documentation, and change history.

Requirements:

**Required experience:**

* Windows Server: 10+ years
* AWS: 5+ years
* ArcGIS Enterprise: 5+ years
* This position requires Security+, candidates will need to already have it or have the ability to get it
* This position requires an active DOW security clearance or the ability to obtain clearance

Company Overview and Benefits:

NV5 delivers technology-enabled engineering, consulting, and geospatial solutions that help clients plan, design, and optimize infrastructure, buildings, utilities, and environmental systems. We bring together technical expertise, data, and innovative thinking to create resilient, high-performance assets. As part of TiC Solutions, alongside Acuren, we share a purpose: **to shape and strengthen the physical world.**

Our work starts with our people. We invest in their growth and never compromise on safety. We work as **one team** across disciplines and geographies, bringing diverse perspectives and a shared purpose to complex challenges.

At NV5, we take pride in high-quality work that creates lasting value for our clients. We challenge the status quo, continuously improve, and turn insight into smarter designs, plans, and solutions. Join us to contribute your expertise and collaborate with our teams to help shape the infrastructure and systems the world relies on.

**Benefits**

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

  

* Competitive Salary
* Medical, dental, and supplemental insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Company paid Life & AD&D
* Company paid Disability
* 401K Plan
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Time Off / Flexible Time Off

jobs.title: Marine Spatial Scientist
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** **Marine Spatial Scientist (Full-Time)**

**Location:** **Remote in the United States**  
**Salary Range: $60,000-80,000 per year**

**Position Summary**

RPI is seeking qualified candidates to support the development of marine spatial planning research and products related to screening and siting of aquaculture, renewable energy, and conservation activities in coastal waters of the U.S

**Key Responsibilities**

* Development of custom geoprocessing tools and data models to support high-end spatial analysis, data analytics, and visualization applications to support decision making
* Perform geospatial and geostatistical analyses
* Organize and input data into databases, maintain accurate detailed records of observations, measurements and results
* Write reports and peer review journal articles
* Set and meet deadlines for completion of work in timely manner
* Work collaboratively in a team environment and contribute to other relevant projects as directed

**Required Qualifications**

* Master of Science in a related area plus 4 years' experience, or Bachelor of Science in related area and 10 years' experience.
* Experience with the automation of data preparation, workflows and spatial processing
* Proficient in the methods, practices and techniques of advanced spatial modeling, including raster and vector analysis and cartography
* Proficiency in Python, including various packages and modules
* Knowledge of geometric networks
* Proficient with ArcMap 10.X, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online
* Ability to maintain focus on routine and repetitive tasks
* Effective verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to be flexible in responding to changes in schedules and job priorities
* Able to work in a team environment
* Ability to work flexible hours, including some long days and infrequently on weekends
* A valid US driver's license
* Experience with basic computer programs such as excel and word

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in marine science
* Experience supporting NOAA or BOEM

**Equal Opportunity Employment**

Research Planning, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our policy of equal employment opportunity applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotions, transfers, discipline, terminations, wage and salary administration, benefits, and training. We are committed to fostering a fair and merit-based workplace where every employee feels valued and respected.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

Please apply directly through our careers portal. No agencies, please.
